items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 23 at 9:20PM EST until November 24 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
expected along shorelines and tidal waterways (7.1 to 7.3 feet
Mean Lower Low Water at Charleston).

* WHERE...Coastal Colleton and Charleston Counties.

* WHEN...From 5 AM to 9 AM EST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...This could result in some roads becoming impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tide will occur around 7 AM Tuesday
morning at Charleston. Saltwater inundation will be possible 1
to 2 hours before and after high tide.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Visit water.weather.gov for additional water level and flood
impact information.

items.headline: Gale Watch issued November 23 at 6:23PM EST until November 26 at 4:00AM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 7 to 12 ft possible.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From Tuesday afternoon through late Wednesday night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
